scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists the ideas every viewer has posted to this app's shared board, with their vote counts.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Posts, edits and withdraws the viewer's own ideas, records their up-votes, and files a report on an idea they flag for moderator review.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Loads the viewer's own unposted draft and the list of ideas they have already reported, which only they can see.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves the viewer's own unposted draft and remembers which ideas they have reported, in their private per-viewer store.
